prompt: Support is drowning in boundary-day complaints. Guests can't make a booking that starts the day the previous guest checks out, trials are running a day longer than the purchased length, invoices keep billing one night too many, and the occupancy report splits a stay in two whenever one guest leaves the morning the next arrives. docs/interval-convention.md pins down which days an interval actually covers; the reproductions under test/ are the cases we managed to isolate, not the whole acceptance criteria.
